name: HomeWizard water meter
description: Water from a HomeWizard water meter on the home network: how much flows now and how many litres were used today, against a typical day.

settings.label: Meter address
settings.help: Switch on Local API for the meter in the HomeWizard Energy app. The meter needs USB power for it; on batteries it only reports to the cloud.

settings.label: A typical day (litres)
settings.help: The ring is full at this many litres; above it, it turns orange.
